messages:
omar_csm: Quick ask  Nimbus wants a short showcase config change for a joint partner session Friday. They need: region pin to eu-west-1, a modest QPS uplift on /v1/generate and /v1/chat, and two CIDRs allowlisted for partner test clients. This demo will influence an upcoming renewal  potential Dedicated upsell. Can we prioritize and keep it auditable?

ivy_support: Ack. Please paste exact CIDRs, org id, target routes, uplift factor, and the window. Also confirm auto-revoke and whether they want a region pin with fallback or hard pin.

Nimbus_OPS: Org id: org_nimbus_77. CIDRs: 203.0.113.45/32 and 198.51.100.0/24. Routes: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Uplift: 1.75x. Window: 2025-09-10T13:00:00Z -> 2025-09-10T15:00:00Z. Auto-revoke: yes. They prefer a soft region pin (prefer eu-west-1, allow fallback if capacity constrained). Contact: showcase@nimbus.ai.

sasha_oncall: Plan: 1) add ACL entries to proxy, 2) apply region_pin eu-west-1 (soft), 3) add per-route qps_override=1.75 for org_nimbus_77, 4) schedule auto-revoke at 15:00Z, 5) add audit metadata initiated_by=omar_csm. Tagging @leo_eng for quick IP/residency check.

leo_eng: Quick review: CIDRs look fine. Approve ACL and soft region pin. Suggest adding a concurrency_cap=1100 on /v1/generate to avoid noisy neighbor OOMs. Approve 1.75x uplift.

ivy_support: I'll stage the patch and smoke then push to eu-west-1. Staging command:

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_nimbus_77 \n  --patch '{"region_pin":"eu-west-1","routes":{"/v1/generate":{"qps_override":1.75,"concurrency_cap":1100},"/v1/chat":{"qps_override":1.75}},"acls":["203.0.113.45/32","198.51.100.0/24"]}' \n  --region eu-west-1 --expires 2025-09-10T15:00:00Z --audit "initiated_by=omar_csm;reason=partner-showcase"
```

ivy_support: staging smoke OK. Rolling to eu-west-1 now  will drop console link and policy ref when live.

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-09-09T20:05:02Z actor=ivy_support status=queued

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=ivy_support status=success time=2025-09-09T20:06:38Z ref=patch-118912

sasha_oncall: Verified ACLs + soft region pin + qps overrides live in eu-west-1. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2025-09-10T15:00:00Z. I'll monitor p50/p95 latency, error rate, and token burn during the window and post anomalies.

Nimbus_OPS: Warmup traffic looks good. Thanks for the quick turnaround. If the showcase converts wed like a follow-up on Dedicated pricing, SLA tiers, and bulk token discounts. Also request a short doc on pre-warm best-practices.

omar_csm: Noted  adding to renewal tracker and will schedule a technical deep-dive next week if demo succeeds. Appreciate the fast assist :rocket:
